segments.text:
V. 44.
And thy children within thee—All the Jews were at that Time gathered together, it being the Time of the Paſſover. They ſhall not leave one ſtone upon another—Only three Towers were left ſtanding for a Time, to ſhew the former Strength and Magnificence of the Place. But theſe likewiſe were afterwards levelled with the Ground.
